note: Rot speed is 0 at or below stopsBelowC, 1 at or above fullSpeedAboveC, linear between, by the temperature of the cell an item lies in (docs/design/spoilage.md). Items with stats.deteriorationRate (hit points a game day) lose it under the open sky, times outdoorDeteriorationFactor (E1 raises it in rain). A meal is poisoned by chance when it is cooked: dirtyKitchenChance in a kitchen at dirtiestAt or worse (nothing at cleanAtLeast or better, linear between) plus unskilledChance for a cook of skill 0 (nothing from skillSafeAt up); eating a poisoned meal gives food poisoning with onIngestChance.
